meta.parties: Sangarapillai v. Indo Lanka Provident Insurance Co., Ltd

rules.statement: An error in the prohibitory notice regarding the name of the judgment-debtor does not render a sale to a bona fide purchaser invalid if it is a misdescription and not an illegality.
rules.supporting_quote: "In the circumstances the error was a misdescription which did not amount to an illegality and that the sale to a bona fide purchaser could not be impugned on that ground by the judgment-debtor."
